channelProvider.title: Channel Provider
channelProvider.summary: WhatsApp or SMS provider credentials and routing priority.
channelProvider.description: ChannelProvider holds credentials, the webhook signing secret, the E.164 sender number and the failover priority for a single tenant-owned WhatsApp or SMS sender. The kind field distinguishes Meta Cloud API direct senders (whatsapp-cloud-api) from BSP-mediated senders (whatsapp-bsp) and from SMS senders (sms). priority orders failover within the same kind. credentials is encrypted at rest by OpenRegister.

credentials.description: Vendor-specific credential bag. Encrypted at rest.

phoneNumber.description: E.164 sender phone number or account identifier.

webhookSecret.description: Shared HMAC secret used to verify inbound webhooks.

active.description: Whether the provider participates in send routing.

sandbox.description: Whether the provider is a sandbox / test account.

priority.description: Failover priority within the same kind; lower wins.

messageTemplate.title: Message Template
messageTemplate.summary: Provider-side message template (WhatsApp HSM) with approval lifecycle.
messageTemplate.description: MessageTemplate is the local mirror of an HSM template registered with a Channel Provider (Meta / BSP). status tracks the provider's approval state; lastSyncedAt records the last successful sync. body is the template text with {{1}}..{{N}} placeholders.

externalId.description: Template name as registered with the provider.

lastSyncedAt.description: ISO 8601 of the last successful provider sync.

messagingConsentRecord.title: Messaging Consent Record
messagingConsentRecord.summary: Per-contact, per-channel consent state for WhatsApp / SMS (immutable audit history).
messagingConsentRecord.description: MessagingConsentRecord captures every opt-in / opt-out event for a contact on a messaging channel. Records are append-only: a new row is written on each state transition; never overwrite history. ConsentService.canSend(...) picks the most recent record for the (contactId, channel) pair as the effective state. Distinct from the marketing consentRecord schema (which only models email).

channel.description: Messaging channel the consent applies to.

state.description: Effective consent state at the recordedAt instant.

source.description: How the consent state was captured.

recordedAt.description: ISO 8601 instant the consent state took effect.

evidence.description: Free-text evidence for the audit trail (e.g. quoted inbound body).

legalBasis.description: GDPR Art. 6 lawful basis used at capture.

messageSendBudget.title: Message Send Budget
messageSendBudget.summary: Per-tenant, per-provider send cap with hard-stop or alert-only enforcement.
messageSendBudget.description: MessageSendBudget governs how many messages and how much cost a tenant may spend through a single provider in one period. hardStop=true blocks further sends once the cap is reached; hardStop=false only alerts (once per period). currentPeriodMessages and currentPeriodCostEur are advanced by BudgetService on each successful send; BudgetPeriodResetJob rolls them on periodResetAt.

tenantId.description: Tenant identifier (typically the NC instance id).

maxMessages.description: Cap on messages per period (0 = no cap).

maxCostEur.description: Cap on cost in EUR per period (0 = no cap).

alertThresholdPct.description: Fraction (0..1) of the cap that triggers a soft-alert.

hardStop.description: When true, refuse sends past the cap; when false, alert only.

currentPeriodMessages.description: Messages already sent in the current period.

currentPeriodCostEur.description: Total EUR cost already accrued in the current period.

periodResetAt.description: ISO 8601 instant the current period ends and counters reset.

alertedAtPeriodStart.description: Set when the one-per-period soft-alert has fired; cleared on reset.

message.title: Message
message.summary: A single message exchanged on a conversation (email, web-form, whatsapp, sms).
message.description: Message is the omnichannel exchange record: one row per inbound or outbound message persisted across all supported channels. The whatsapp-sms-channel-adapter change extends it with providerId, externalMessageId, templateId, costEur, deliveryStatus and windowExpiresAt. channel.enum is extended to include whatsapp and sms.

channel.description: Channel the message was exchanged on.

direction.description: Whether the message was received or sent.

providerId.description: FK to channelProvider that handled this message.

externalMessageId.description: Provider-side message id (Meta wamid, Twilio SID, etc.).

templateId.description: FK to messageTemplate (UUID) when sent as a template.

templateParameters.description: Positional template parameters as sent to the provider.

costEur.description: Captured cost in EUR (may be estimated; see metadata.costEstimated).

windowExpiresAt.description: WhatsApp 24-hour customer-service window expiry derived from the most recent inbound.

metadata.description: Provider-specific extras (cost currency, ecb rate, media, antivirus, estimation flag).

sentAt.description: ISO 8601 instant the message was sent or received.

conversation.title: Conversation
conversation.summary: A threaded omnichannel exchange between an agent and a contact on a single channel.
conversation.description: Conversation groups messages for one contact on one channel (per the channel-threading invariant in design.md). The KCC queue routes new conversations; agents handle them until completedAt is set.

providerId.description: FK to channelProvider that owns this conversation.

assignedTo.description: Nextcloud user id of the assigned agent.

lastInboundAt.description: ISO 8601 of the last inbound message (drives session window).

windowExpiresAt.description: WhatsApp 24h window expiry mirrored on the conversation for fast queries.
